propositions: /rerun and recheck-review requests are enqueued only to a process-local asyncio queue; if the receiver exits before dequeue, the request is lost and reconciliation skips the already-voted revision

Gerrit holds the stale nonzero LLM-Review vote and SQLite holds the matching voted row after process loss, so reconciliation consulting local dedup first skips the revision before it can be re-reviewed

The approved contract requires an accepted request to reset the exact revision to neutral LLM-Review: 0 first, emit a fresh patchset-bearing Gerrit comment-added event as the durable marker, then reset the attempt budget and enqueue the forced event

Reconciliation must query Gerrit before trusting local dedup; a definitive no-vote read clears the exact stale dedup row and invokes the voter, while a Gerrit read error preserves dedup and holds the cursor back
An untrusted contributor comment cannot choose a label value; only after privileged eligibility succeeds may the bot invoke the fixed-neutral reset operation with value exactly 0

The repair is proven by a stateful test that discards the old queue after acceptance, starts an empty replacement queue, and verifies reconciliation consumes the reset-emitted event to cast exactly one new vote
